fact: The Bureau of Statistics and Census announced the launch of the general population census project, stalled since 2006, with work starting by preparing satellite-image maps of the enumeration units, per the Minister of Planning's press conference on Monday 14 August 2023.
title: مصلحة الإحصاء تطلق مشروع التعداد العام للسكان المتوقف منذ العام 2006
